One meta-reference to the marker string in research.md; rewording so no unresolved-marker text remains anywhere.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('specs/001-transactions/research.md')
t = p.read_text()
t = t.replace(
    'All technical-context unknowns were resolved during research; no\nNEEDS CLARIFICATION markers remain in plan.md. Open item from the spec\n(Assumption A2: error type of a missing-ID remove) is resolved below (D2).',
    'All technical-context unknowns were resolved during research; plan.md\ncontains no unresolved clarification markers. Open item from the spec\n(Assumption A2: error type of a missing-ID remove) is resolved below (D2).')
assert 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' not in t
p.write_text(t)
print('ok')
EOF
grep -c 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' specs/001-transactions/*.md specs/001-transactions/contracts/*.md; echo ---; sed -n '1,8p' specs/001-transactions/research.md"}
